preguntaEn: WHEN YOU ARE UNCOUPLING A LOADED TRAILER, YOU SHOULD LOWER THE LANDING GEAR UNTIL IT:
opcionesEn: MAKES FIRM CONTACT WITH THE GROUND, THEN CRANK IT IN LOW GEAR A FEW EXTRA TURNS.
MAKE CONTACT WITH THE GROUND AND LIFTS THE TRAILER OFF THE FIFTH WHEEL.
JUST REACHES THE GROUND.

preguntaEn: WHEN YOU GET READY TO BACK UNDER A SEMITRAILER YOU SHOULD LINE UP:
opcionesEn: THE KINGPIN TO ENGAGE THE DRIVER’S SIDE LOCKING JAW FIRST.
DIRECTLY IN FRONT OF THE TRAILER.
THE LEFT REAR OUTER DUAL WHEEL WITH THE KINGPIN.

preguntaEn: YOU HAVE COUPLED WITH A SEMITRAILER. WHEN SHOULD YOU PUT THE FRONT TRAILER SUPPORTS BEFORE DRIVING AWAY?
opcionesEn: RAISED ½ WAY WITH THE CRANK HANDLE SECURED IN ITS BRACKET.
FULLY RAISED WITH THE CRANK HANDLE SECURED IN ITS BRACKET.
RAISED ¾ WAY WITH CRANK HANDLE REMOVED.

preguntaEn: YOU SHOULD NOT BACK A TRACTOR UNDER A TRAILER UNTIL WHOLE AIR SYSTEM IS:
opcionesEn: EMPTY.
AT NORMAL PRESSURE.
BETWEEN 60 AND 80 PSI.

preguntaEn: AIR AND ELECTRICAL LINES FROM THE TRACTOR TO THE TRAILER SHOULD BE:
opcionesEn: PULLED TIGHT, WITH VERY LITTLE SLACK.
SECURED, BUT WITH ENOUGH SLACK FOR TURNS.
RESTING ON THE FRAME OF THE TRACTOR.

preguntaEn: AFTER THE TRAILER HAS BEEN COUPLED TO THE TRACTOR, THE TRACTOR PROTECTION CONTROL VALVE SHOULD BE PLACED IN __________ POSITIONX.
opcionesEn: DOWN.
UP.
NORMAL.

preguntaEn: WHEN YOU ARE ALLOWED TO GET OUT OF YOUR VEHICLE WHILE BACKING?
opcionesEn: WHEN YOU ARE UNSURE OF YOUR PATH OF TRAVEL.
WHEN YOUR TRAILER BEGINS TO DRIFTS TO PASSENGER SIDE.
YOU SHOULD NEVER GET OUT OF YOUR VEHICLE WHEN BACKING.

preguntaEn: WHEN COUPLING, THE PROPER POSITION OF THE FIFTH WHEEL IS:
opcionesEn: LEVEL WITH THE GROUND.
TILTED DOWN TOWARD THE END OF THE TRAILER.
TILTED UP TOWARD THE END THE TRAILER.

preguntaEn: HOW SHOULD YOU TEST THE TRACTOR-SEMITRAILER CONNECTION FOR SECURITY?
opcionesEn: LOOK AT IT CAREFULLY.
ROCK THE TRAILER BACK AND FORTH WITH THE TRAILER BRAKES LOCKED.
PULL GENTLY FORWARD IN LOW GEAR AGAINST THE LOCKED TRAILER BRAKES THEN LOOK AT IT CAREFULLY.

preguntaEn: YOU SUPPLY AIR TO THE TRAILER TANKS BY:
opcionesEn: PUSHING IN THE TRAILER AIR SUPPLY VALVE.
PULLING OUT THE TRAILER AIR SUPPLY VALVE.
CONNECTING THE SERVIVCE LINE GLAD HANDS.

preguntaEn: A TRACTOR WITH A (N) _________ TRAILER REQUIRES THE SHORTEST AMOUNT OF STOPPING DISTANCE.
opcionesEn: EMPTY.
LIGHTLY LOADED.
FULLY LOADED.

preguntaEn: WHEN DO YOU NEED TO USE CHOCKS TO PARK A TRAILER?
opcionesEn: NEVER.
ALWAYS.
ONLY WHEN IT WILL BE PARKED ON AN INCLINE.

preguntaEn: SEMITRAILERS MADE BEFORE 1975 THAT ARE EQUIPPED WITH THE AIR BRAKES:
opcionesEn: USUALLY NEED A GLAD HAND CONVERTER.
OFTEN DO NOT HAVE SPRING BRAKES.
HAVE ONLY A SERVICE AIR LINE.

preguntaEn: THE TRACTOR PROTECTION VALVE WILL CLOSE AND THE TRAILER EMERGENCY BRAKES WILL COME ON WHEN THERE IS A MAJOR LEAK IN THE _______ BRAKE LINE.
opcionesEn: SERVICE.
PARKING.
EMERGENCY.

preguntaEn: YOU ARE COUPLING TRACTOR TO A SEMITRAILER. YOU HAVE CONNECTED THE AIRLINES. BEFORE BACKING UNDER THE TRAILER YOU SHOULD:
opcionesEn: SUPPLY AIR TO THE TRAILER SYSTEM, THEM PULL OUT THE AIR SUPPLY KNOB.
PULL AHEAD TO TEST THE GLAD HANDS CONNECTIONS.
MAKE SURE THAT THE TRAILER BRAKES ARE OFF.

preguntaEn: THE SAFETY CATCH FOR THE FIFTH WHEEL LOCKING LEVER MUST BE________ FOR A COUPLING TO BE COMPLETE.
opcionesEn: OVER THE LOCKING LEVER.
STRAIGHT UP.
THROUGH THE LOCKING LEVER.

preguntaEn: THE ARE TWO THINGS THAT A DRIVER CAN DO TO PREVENT A ROLLOVER. THEY ARE: (1) GO SLOW AROUND TURNS; AND (2):
opcionesEn: KEEP BOTH HANDS FIRMLY ON THE STEERING WHEEL.
KEEP THE CARGO AS CLOSE TO THE GROUND AS POSSIBLE.
MAKE SURE THAT THE BRAKES ARE PROPERLY BALANCED.

preguntaEn: LOSS OF AIR PRESSURE IN THE EMERGENCY LINE CAUSES:
opcionesEn: THE RELAY VALVES TO CLOSE.
AN INCREASE IN AIR PRESSURE TO THE SERVICE BRAKES.
THE TRAILER’S EMERGENCY BRAKES TO COME ON.

preguntaEn: YOU ARE ABOUT TO BACK YOUR TRACTOR UNDER A SEMITRAILER. THE TRAILER IS AT THE RIGHT HEIGHT WHEN THE:
opcionesEn: THE KINGPIN IS ABOUT 1 ¼ INCHES ABOVE THE FIFTH WHEEL.
THE END OF THE KING IS EVEN WITH THE TOP OF THE FIFTH WHEEL.
IT WILL BE RAISED SLIGHTLY WHEN THE TRAILER IS BACKED UNDER IT.

preguntaEn: A DRIVER CROSSES THE AIR LINES WHEN HOOKING UP TO AN OLD TRAILER. WHAT WILL HAPPEN?
opcionesEn: THE HAND VALVE WILL APPLY THE TRACTOR BRAKES INSTEAD OF THE TRAILER BRAKES.
IF THE TRAILERS HAS NO SPRING BRAKES, HE OR SHE COULD DRIVE AWAY BUT YOU WOULDN’T HAVE TRAILER BRAKES.
THE BRAKE PEDAL WILL WORK THE TRAILER SPRING BRAKES INSTEAD OF THE AIR BRAKES.

preguntaEn: HOW MUCH SPACE SHOULD BE ALLOWED BETWEEN UPPER AND LOWER FIFTH WHEEL AFTER COUPLING?
opcionesEn: ABOUT ¼ INCH.
JUST ENOUGH TO SEE LIGHT THROUGH IT.
NONE.

preguntaEn: AFTER YOU LOCK THE KINGPIN INTO THE FIFTH WHEEL, YOU SHOULD CHECK THE CONNECTION BY:
opcionesEn: PULLING FORWARD 50 FEET, TURNING RIGHT AND THEN LEFT.
PULLING THE TRACTOR AHEAD SHARPLY TO RELEASE THE TRAILER BRAKES.
PULLING THE TRACTOR AHEAD GENTLY WITH THE TRAILER BRAKES LOCKED.

preguntaEn: WHILE DRIVING BEHIND OTHER VEHICLE UNDER GOOD CONDITION YOU SHOULD ALLOW AT LEAST ONE SECOND BETWEEN YOUR VEHICLE AND THE VEHICLE AHEAD FOR EACH_____ (HOW MANY) FEET OF YOUR VEHICLE LENGTH?
OFF-TRACKING OR ‘’CHEATING’’ CAUSES WHICH OF THESE TO FOLLOW THE WIDEST PATH WHILE MAKING A TURN?
opcionesEn: 5-AXLE TRACTOR TOWING A 45 FEET TRAILER.
5-AXLE TRACTOR TOWING 27 FEET TRAILERS.
A BOBTAIL.

preguntaEn: THE AIR LEAKAGE RATE FOR A COMBINATION VEHICLE (ENGINE OFF, BRAKES OFF) SHOULD BE LESS THAN _____ PSI PER MINUTE.
opcionesEn: ½ .

preguntaEn: WHEN CHECKING THE TRAILER’S EMERGENCY BRAKES, THE TRACTOR PROTECTION CONTROL VALVE SHOULD BE PLACED IN THE _______ POSITION.
opcionesEn: NORMAL.
EMERGENCY.
NEUTRAL.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE STATEMENTS IS TRUE?
opcionesEn: THE BRAKES AND SUSPENSION SYSTEM OF COMBINATION VEHICLES WORK BEST WITH A LIGHT LOAD.
LIGHT VEHICLES NEED MORE BRAKING POWER TO STOP THAN HEAVY ONES.
‘’BOBTAIL’’ TRACTORS CAN TAKE LONG TO STOP THAN A COMBINATION VEHICLE LOADED TO MAXIMUM GROSS WEIGHT.

preguntaEn: THERE ARE TWO THINGS THAT A DRIVER CAN DO TO PREVENT A ROLLOVER THEY ARE: (1) KEEP THE CARGO AS CLOSE TO THE GROUND AS POSSIBLE; AND(2):
opcionesEn: MAKE SURE THAT THE BRAKES ARE PROPERLY ADJUSTED.
KEEP BOTH HANDS FIRMLY ON THE STEERING WHEEL.
GO SLOW AROUND TURNS.

preguntaEn: WHAT GEAR SHOULD THE TRACTOR TRANSMISSION BE IN AFTER YOU HAVE UNCOUPLED THE TRAILER AND ARE INSPECTING THE TRAILER SUPPORTS?
opcionesEn: NEUTRAL.
LOW REVERSE.
HIGH REVERSE.

preguntaEn: HAVING ANTILOCK BRAKES ON ONLY YOUR TRAILER.
opcionesEn: WILL GIVE YOU MORE CONTROL OVER THE VEHICLE WHEN BRAKING.
WILL INCREASE THE LIKELIHOOD OF A REAR WHEEL POWER UNTIL SKID WHEN BRAKING.
WILL INCREASE THE LIKELIHOOD OF JACKKNIFING WHEN BRAKING.

preguntaEn: WHEN SHOULD YOU GET OUT OF YOUR VEHICLE WHEN YOUR ARE BACKING WITH A TRAILER?
opcionesEn: WHEN YOU ARE UNSURE OF YOUR PATH OF TRAVEL.
YOU SHOULD NEVER GET OUT OF YOUR VEHICLE WHEN BACKING.
WHEN YOUR TRAILER BEGINGS TO DRIFT TO PASSENGER SIDE.

preguntaEn: WHEN UNCOUPLING THE TRAILER, AFTER YOU HAVE SHUT OFF THE TRAILER AIR SUPPLY AND LOCKED THE TRAILER BRAKES, YOU SHOULD:
opcionesEn: BACK UP GENTLY TO ESASE PRESSURE ON THE FIFTH WHEEL LOCKING JAWS.
IMMEDIATELY PUT ON YOUR TRACTOR PARKING BRAKES.
BEGIN TO LOWER THE TRAILER LANDING GEAR.

preguntaEn: WHAT WILL HAPPEN IF THE AIR LINES ARE CROSSED WHEN YOU HOOK UP TO AN OLD TRAILER?
opcionesEn: THE HAND VALVE WILL APPLY THE TRACTOR BRAKES INSTEAD OF THE TRAILER BRAKES.
IF THE TRAILER HAS NO SPRING BRAKES, YOU COULD DRIVE AWAY BUT YOU WOULD NOT HAVE TRAILER BRAKES.
THE BRAKE LIGHTS WILL NOT COME ON WHEN YOU PRESS THE BRAKE PEDAL.

preguntaEn: THE AIR LEAKAGE RATE FOR A COMBINATION VEHICLE (ENGINE OFF, BRAKES ON) SHOULD BE LESS THAN _______ PSI PER MINUTE.
THE EARLIEST AND BEST WAY TO RECOGNIZE THAT THE TRAILER HAS STARTED TO SKID IS BY:
opcionesEn: SEEING IT IN YOUR MIRRORS.
FEEL FOR ‘’PULLING’’ IN THE CAB.
HEAR THE WHEELS SKIDDING.

preguntaEn: THE AIR LEAKAGE RATE FOR A COMBINATION VEHICLE (ENGINE OFF, BRAKES ON) SHOULD BE LESS THAN ______ PSI PER MINUTE.
opcionesEn: TWO
THREE.
FOUR.

preguntaEn: THE FRONT TRAILER SUPPORTS ARE UP AND THE TRAILER IS RESTING ON THE TRACTOR. MAKE SURE:
opcionesEn: THERE IS ENOUGH CLEARANCE BETWEEN THE TOP OF THE TRACTOR TIRES AND NOSE OF THE TRAILER.
THERE IS ENOUGH CLEARANCE BETWEEN THE TRACTOR FRAME AND THE LANDING GEAR.
BOTH A AND B ARE CORRECT.

preguntaEn: WHEN DRIVING A SET OF DOUBLES, IT IS NECESSARY TO CLOSE THE ____ SHUT-OFF VALVE IN THE LAST TRAILER.
opcionesEn: FRONT.
MID-SECTION.
BACK

preguntaEn: A TRAILER IS MOST LIKELY TO JACKKNIFE WHEN IT IS______.
opcionesEn: LOADED TO FULL CAPACITY.
OVER LOADED.
EMPTY.

preguntaEn: WHEN CONNECTING THE GLAD HANDS, PRESS THE TWO SEALS OF THE COUPLERS TOGETHER AT A ________ DEGREE ANGLE TO ONE ANOTHER.
WHICH PART OF THE KINGPIN IS SHOULD BE LOCKING JAWS CLOSE AROUND?
opcionesEn: THE SHANK.
THE HEAD.
THE BASE.

preguntaEn: THE HAND VALVE SHOULD BE USED:
opcionesEn: ONLY WITH A FOOT BRAKE.
TO TEST THE TRAILER BRAKES.
AS A PARKING BRAKE.

preguntaEn: OFF-TRACKING OR ‘’CHEATING’’ CAUSES OF WHICH OF THESE TO FOLLOW THE WIDER PATH WHILE MAKING A TURN?
opcionesEn: TRIPPLE TOWING A 45 FEET TRAILER.
TRACTOR WITH TWO 27 FEET TRAILERS.
53-FEET BOBTAIL.

preguntaEn: IF YOUR ANTILOCK BRAKING SYSTEM IS NOT WORKING ON YOUR TRAILER, YOU SHOULD:
opcionesEn: DRIVE AT A LOWER SPEED AND GET THE SYSTEM SERVICED SOON.
NOT DRIVE UNTIL IT IS REPAIRED.
DRIVE NORMALLY, BUT GET THE SYSTEM SERVICED SOON.

preguntaEn: YOU ARE COUPLING A TRACTOR TO A SEMITRAILER AND HAVE BACKED UP BUT ARE NOT UNDER IT. WHAT SHOULD YOU HOOK UP BEFORE BAKCING UNDER?
opcionesEn: THE EMERGENCY AND SERVICE AIR LINES.
THE ELECTRICAL SERVICE CABLE.
NOTHING. BACK UP AND LOCK THE FIFTH WHEEL.

preguntaEn: YOU WILL KNOW IF THE TRAILER ABS BRAKES ARE NOT WORKING PROPERLY BY:
opcionesEn: YELLOW ABS MALFUNCTION LAMPS ON THE LEFT SIDE OF THE TRAILER STAYS ON.
YELLOW ABS MALFUNCTION LAMPS ON THE RIGHT SIDE OF THE TRIALER STAYS ON.
RED MALFUNCTION LAMPS ON THE TRAILER BRAKE CYLINDERS STAYS ON.

preguntaEn: AIR BRAKE EQUIPPED TRAILERS MADE BEFORE 1975.
opcionesEn: OFTEN DO NOT HAVE SPRING BRAKES.
USUALLY NEED A GLAD HAND CONVERTER.
CANNOT BE LEGALLY OPERATED ON INTERSTATE HIGHWAYS.

preguntaEn: WHERE SHOUL THE TRACTOR BE WHEN YOU INSPECT LANDING GEAR AFTER UNCOUPLING THE TRAILER?
opcionesEn: WITH THE TRACTOR FRAME UNDER THE TRAILER.
COMPLETELY CLEARED FROM THE TRAILER.
WITH THE FIFTH WHEEL DIRECTLY BENEATH THE KINGPIN.

preguntaEn: COMPARED TO A STRAIGHT TRUCK OR BUS, THERE ARE_____ THINGS TO INSPECT IN COMBINATION VEHICLE.
opcionesEn: FEWER.
THE SAME NUMBER OF.
MORE.

preguntaEn: YOUR EMERGENCY AIR LINE BREAKS OR GETS PULLED APART WHILE YOU ARE DRIVING. THE LOSS OF PRESSURE WILL CAUSE THE:
opcionesEn: AIR COMPRESSOR TO UNLOAD INSTEAD OF PUMPING AIR.
EMERGENCY TRAILER BRAKES TO COME ON.
TRAILER SUPPLY VALVE TO OPEN.
